pages.title: Bubble Watch
pages.text: Marine planks frame the controlled passage and a music disc brings the coast’s atmosphere to the home camp.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Honeycomb starts the Stranded native wake sequence. An axe returns an active Stranded to its frozen state. Complete both transitions and separately release a living creature from a real crab bubble
